'''''Life Day 2009''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The painting depicted several [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] circling around a tree with various decorations, as well as [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] ominously observing in the background. It was supplied during the events of an annual [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] celebration on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].

==Behind the scenes==
''Life Day 2009'', as the title implies, was given out to players during the 2009 festivities of Life Day. It can be purchased with 50 Rebel tokens or Imperial tokens, or it can be randomly given as a gift under the Life Day Tree.
